stack: TBD by replica-architect (web-first + installable PWA member side)

recon_from: public class-schedule and booking pages of real studios
the user's OWN trial account if one exists
never: copy code, logo, copy, images, fonts, or content

features.name: Class schedule and member booking
features.acceptance: Owner publishes a weekly schedule; a member books a class from the public page in under 30 seconds without creating an account for a drop-in.
features.verify: e2e: publish class -> book as guest -> assert booking recorded and capacity decremented

features.name: Memberships, class packs, drop-ins, expiring credits
features.acceptance: Each product type deducts correctly on booking; credits carry an expiry; an expired credit cannot be used.
features.verify: unit table: deduct/expire/exhaust for each product type incl. boundary dates

features.name: Bring-your-own Stripe, no platform percentage
features.acceptance: Studio connects its own Stripe in test mode; a member pays end-to-end with a test card; assert zero platform fee line and zero application-fee is set on the payment intent.
features.verify: integration: Stripe test payment -> assert application_fee_amount is null/0

features.name: Attendance and check-in
features.acceptance: Member self check-in and staff manual check-in both work; attendance is recorded per class instance and is idempotent.
features.verify: e2e: two check-in paths -> assert one attendance row each, no duplicates

features.name: Automated reminders
features.acceptance: Reminder timing is configurable; queued jobs are idempotent and respect member opt-out.
features.verify: unit: scheduler + opt-out respected; assert no duplicate sends

features.name: Waitlist with auto-promotion
features.acceptance: Full class offers a waitlist; cancelling a booking promotes the first waitlisted member, notifies them, and gives a bounded window to claim before moving on.
features.verify: integration: fill class -> waitlist 2 -> cancel 1 -> assert promotion order, notification, and timeout fallback

features.name: Late-cancel / no-show policy automation
features.acceptance: Configurable cancellation window; late cancel applies the configured fee or credit deduction automatically; member sees the outcome immediately.
features.verify: unit+integration: cancel before/after window -> assert correct fee/credit outcome

features.name: Revenue reporting
features.acceptance: Reports revenue by class and by membership for a date range; totals reconcile exactly with the payment ledger. Expiring-in-14-days list is produced.
features.verify: integration: seed known ledger -> assert report totals equal ledger totals exactly

features.name: Free CSV migration/import
features.acceptance: Imports members and remaining balances from a CSV with field mapping and a dry-run preview; bad rows are reported, not silently dropped.
features.verify: integration: import fixture incl. bad rows -> assert balances correct + bad rows reported

features.name: PWA member experience
features.acceptance: Member side installs as a PWA, loads offline for a previously visited schedule, and is usable at 375px width.
features.verify: e2e: Lighthouse/installability check + offline reload + mobile viewport screenshot diff
